integrity: The unrestricted theorem has an explicit proof. The standalone finite breadth-first search is supplementary; no independent audit or independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact distance only for the two prescribed fully saturated adjacent configurations, not all distances or the diameter. Assumes finite connected simple host with at least three vertices and capacity at least two. Historical priority is provisional; the complete-graph/triangle instance is already covered by Cai et al.
title: A sharp edge-girth law for exchanging two saturated labelled-token stacks
